title: Mirasol House | 41 Sunflower Street WaterColor Vacation Home – Dune Vacation Rentals
meta_description: This stunning WaterColor vacation home offers 4 spacious bedrooms, a private pool and an outdoor grill station. Enjoy the breathtaking views and luxury amenities. Book now!
description_expanded:
Mirasol House | Crossings District, WaterColor

41 Sunflower Street Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

‘Mirasol House' is an absolutely stunning home that resides in the WaterColor community! This 4 bed/bonus bunk space/4 bath home in the Crossings District is elegantly designed with upscale finishes that can be found throughout the open air concept. You can cruise around to the many amenities WaterColor has to offer on the provided 6 seat Golf Cart/LSV. The private pool, outdoor grill station, and fireplace are just as luxurious as the interior of the home!

Start your vacation off by relaxing on the wooden front porch that is complete with a charming porch swing. This home is a first time rental furnished with warm walnut floors, shiplap walls, and prestigious decor. No detail was overlooked in the gourmet kitchen with Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, a wine cooler, and a gorgeous marble island perfect for mealtime. The open concept kitchen, dining, and living room provide plenty of space but allows you to stay connected with your guest. The first floor bedroom features a beautifully designed space with a king size mattress and ensuite bathroom. Unwind on the covered deck with pleasant, scenic views of the backyard, or enjoy an afternoon snack on the grill. The outdoor living space is simply peaceful and will leave you wishing your vacation never had to end. This space is complete with an outdoor shower that makes washing sand off a breeze.

On the second floor is the master bedroom with a king sized bed, ensuite bathroom, and a private deck that is perfect for reading a good book. Also, on the second floor are the two queen guest bedrooms as well as three bathrooms. The bonus bunk space has two sets of twin over twin bunk beds and a comfortable sitting area.

‘41 Sunflower' supplies you with the luxury you and your family deserve while vacationing in WaterColor!

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Home Highlights

Sleeps 12

4 Bedrooms + Bunk Room

4 Bathrooms

2,774 Square Feet

Private Pool (can be heated for $65/day)

Outdoor Fireplace + Grill Station

6 Seat Golf Cart/LSV

First Floor Bedroom

Bonus Bunk Space on Second Floor

Spacious Gourmet Kitchen

Complimentary Trolley Rides via WaterColor Trolley App

12 Amenity Wristbands

Access to All WaterColor Community Swimming Pools - Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club

First Floor

- Wooden front porch accompanied by a beautiful porch swing

- King bedroom with ensuite bath featuring a soaking tub

- Open space concept flows from the kitchen to living room with plenty of room for everyone

- Upscale kitchen complete with Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, a wine cooler, marble countertops, and an immense breakfast bar

- Backyard is complete with a covered deck, outdoor shower, and a gas grill

Second Floor

- King master bedroom with ensuite bath featuring double vanity, shower, and a soaking tub. Private access to a covered deck.

- Queen bedroom with ensuite bathroom

- Queen bedroom that shares a bathroom with the bunk space

- Bunk space complete with 2 sets of twin bunk beds and a sitting area. The bunk space shares a bathroom with the queen bedroom.

Outdoor Space

- 6 seat golf cart/LSV is available for use with the home. Only licensed drivers 21 and older may drive the cart/LSV.

- Covered deck that is great for conversation or grilling your next meal

- Scenic backyard perfect for relaxing

- Private pool (can be heated for $65/day)

Additional

- Guests can enjoy complimentary rides anywhere in WaterColor using the on-demand WaterColor Trolley, available through the WaterColor Trolley app in your app store.

- Parking for 2 Vehicles

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees will apply.

- No pet home. Per the signed Rental Agreement, any violation of the no pet policy will result in immediate eviction, plus additional cleaning charges.

- WaterColor HOA allows one golf cart/LSV per address- you may not rent a second cart/LSV if the home you have rented offers one. All golf cart/LSV rentals in Watercolor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to a specific amount throughout the community at any given time. Cart/LSV rentals are granted on a first-come, first-served based. Watercolor condos cannot rent golf carts/LSV.

- 12 Amenity Wristbands - Maximum. Extras are not available. Access to All WaterColor Community Swimming Pools - Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club.

- The HOA issues one parking pass per reservation. Guests are encouraged to park their vehicles in the driveway or garage of their rental home. They do not need a parking pass when their vehicle is parked on a private residential property.The HOA-issued parking pass is required to park a vehicle overnight on the common area parking pads.

Pool/Spa: This home may have a private pool and/or spa. Seasonal pool/spa heating is available upon request for $65/day plus tax. These cannot be heated separately as the water flows from the spa into the pool. If one is heated, they are both heated. Maximum temp for Pool is 90 degrees. Maximum temp for spa is 100 degrees. Pool and/or spa heat is not available during the warmer months from Memorial Day to September 30th.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum Age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking

- Except for a $250 cancelation fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancelations are given 60 days prior to arrival date

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to arrival date

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
